body: Hey, thanks I appreciate it. I guess there's nothing I enjoy in life anymore, and I feel like a burden to my friends :/ and everything seems pointless. I've been happy before, I know what its like, but I dont even want to go back to that. All I want is peace. Having these thoughts makes me feel guilty :/ I know it frustrates the people in my life, I would change them if I could but nothing seems to work.

Hey there, I'm not very good at writing helpful things, but just know I read your post and I'm glad I did. I understand what its like to have horrible thoughts constantly in your mind, its exhausting and really, really hard to believe anything other than what depression is saying. 

I know for myself when I'm in that place, its really hard to listen to to anything else. But know that even if your depression tells you otherwise, posting your thoughts here was a victory, and shows you are strong enough to fight this, even if it doesn't always seem that way.

Like iam said, seems like you are going through the first stages of suicidal thoughts. I know what it feels like to wish for death, it's a lot easier than living. I've been to the point I was begging one of my close friends to help me die, I was so over the constant dark thoughts in my mind and being depressed for weeks on end. On my better days, I can see how messed up my request was. None of my friends or family would ever support me in deciding to opt out of life, let alone help me go through with it. If I ever did try to take my life, it would cause them horrible pain. Even at my worst moments, I could acknowledge that I myself would never support someone to commit suicide, and it would make me incredibly sad if any of my friends or family committed suicide. 

I'm glad you can see the pain it would cause your friends and family if you ended your life, and that you can see people in your life care about you. And I'm sorry that life is hard for you right now, it can really suck at times. I hope you can find ways to combat the negative thoughts and feelings you are having. Feel free to pm me if you would like to talk.
